categories.main_business_segments: Poly Property Services Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: property management services, value-added services to non-property owners, and community value-added services. These segments cover residential communities, commercial and office buildings, and public and other properties, forming a comprehensive property ecosystem.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes smart property and innovation, including the development of smart community tools and the RADAR smart service system. It promotes standardised construction and modular disassembly of services, transitioning from bespoke to prefabricated services. Digital intelligence and informatization are integrated into service and management processes to enhance efficiency and customer experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include property developers (notably Poly Developments and Holdings Group), residential property owners, commercial office tenants, public institutions, and urban service entities. The company serves a diversified customer base across residential, commercial, public, and community sectors, including higher education, transportation, hospitals, and government offices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates extensively across China, covering 210 cities in 29 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. Its contracted gross floor area spans approximately 771.6 million sq.m., with a management footprint in major first- and second-tier cities. The company also maintains a principal place of business in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Poly Property operates primarily in the downstream segment of the property ecosystem, providing property management and related value-added services. It acts as a service provider to property developers and owners, managing properties and offering community services rather than engaging in property development or construction.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on high-quality development, intensive market cultivation, and expansion in core cities and sub-sector businesses. It prioritizes innovation in smart property services, digitalization, lean management, and the development of integrated community value-added services. R&D efforts include smart community facilities, IoT platforms, and digital operation systems to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through fees from property management services, value-added services to non-property owners (such as pre-delivery services and office leasing), and community value-added services including retail, move-in and furnishing, parking lot services, and space operation. The model combines service fees, leasing income, and transaction-based revenues.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Poly Property is a leading property management service provider in China, ranked third among the Top 100 Property Management Companies and first among state-owned background companies by management scale. It competes with other large property management firms, leveraging its state-owned background, extensive scale, and comprehensive service offerings to maintain a strong market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB13.69 billion, a 26.9% increase year-on-year, with a profit attributable to owners of RMB1.11 billion, up 31.6%. The company manages over 576 million sq.m. of gross floor area and continues to expand its contracted projects and service scale, demonstrating steady growth and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Poly Property emphasizes high-quality, comprehensive property management services with strong brand reputation and state-owned background. It differentiates through integrated service offerings across residential, commercial, and public sectors, smart and digitalized service platforms, and tailored community value-added services. The company’s strategic focus on innovation, customer-centric product development, and intensive market cultivation enhances its competitive edge.
